fields.label: Rule Name
fields.description: A human-readable name for this rule, e.g. 'Sketch files → 02-SKETCH UP'.

fields.label: Rule Type
fields.description: Cross-route: auto-post specific file types to a secondary folder. Mirror: duplicate ALL uploads from a source folder prefix into a parallel target folder, preserving subfolder structure.

fields.label: File Classification
fields.options:
Presentation Files
Drawing / Layout Files
3D Model Files
Feasibility / Area Calculation Files
Editable Design Source Files
Rendering / Image Files
Submission Files
Uncategorized
fields.description: Which auto-detected file classification triggers this rule.

fields.label: Source Folder Pattern
fields.description: Text to match in the upload target folder's label path (e.g. '01-CONCEPT STUDIES'). Case-insensitive.

fields.label: Source Match Mode
fields.description: How to compare the source folder label against the pattern.

fields.label: Target Folder Pattern
fields.description: Cross-route: text to match in a target folder label — first match wins. Mirror: the destination folder prefix (e.g. '03-BALADIYA/01-DOCUMENTS') — subfolder structure from source is replicated here.

fields.label: Target Match Mode
fields.description: How to compare target folder labels against the pattern.
